label: Authorize explicit failed-order resolution without rewriting visit history

precheck.description: require audit foundation and no duplicate guard
precheck.sql: SELECT to_regprocedure('public.dispatch_audit_actor_guard()') IS NOT NULL AND to_regprocedure('public.dispatch_review_resolution_guard()') IS NULL AS result

execute.description: install agreement resolution and retain historical failures

postcheck.sql: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_trigger WHERE tgname = 'dispatch_review_resolution' AND tgenabled = 'O') AS result

precheck.sql:
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT o.id FROM public."order" o
  JOIN public."routeStop" st ON st."orderId" = o.id
  JOIN public."deliveryAttempt" d ON d."stopId" = st.id AND d.outcome = 'FAILED'
  WHERE NOT o."requiresAdministrativeReview" AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public."dispatchIntervention" a WHERE a.action = 'RESCHEDULE' AND a.outcome = 'APPLIED'
      AND a."orderId" = o.id AND a.result::jsonb ->> 'attemptId' = d.id
  ) LIMIT 1) AS ok

execute.sql:
SELECT o.id FROM public."order" o
  JOIN public."routeStop" st ON st."orderId" = o.id
  JOIN public."deliveryAttempt" d ON d."stopId" = st.id AND d.outcome = 'FAILED'
  WHERE NOT o."requiresAdministrativeReview" AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public."dispatchIntervention" a WHERE a.action = 'RESCHEDULE' AND a.outcome = 'APPLIED'
      AND a."orderId" = o.id AND a.result::jsonb ->> 'attemptId' = d.id
  ) LIMIT 1

postcheck.sql:
SELECT NOT EXISTS (SELECT o.id FROM public."order" o
  JOIN public."routeStop" st ON st."orderId" = o.id
  JOIN public."deliveryAttempt" d ON d."stopId" = st.id AND d.outcome = 'FAILED'
  WHERE NOT o."requiresAdministrativeReview" AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public."dispatchIntervention" a WHERE a.action = 'RESCHEDULE' AND a.outcome = 'APPLIED'
      AND a."orderId" = o.id AND a.result::jsonb ->> 'attemptId' = d.id
  ) LIMIT 1) AS ok
